connector.name: Claude MCP Bridge
connector.registryDescription: Wraps Claude Code CLI as MCP tools: query, search, structured, ping, listSessions.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package claude-mcp-bridge. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the hampsterx account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CLAUDE_CLI_PATH
env.description: Path to the claude CLI binary. Defaults to 'claude' on PATH.

env.name: CLAUDE_DEFAULT_MODEL
env.description: Shared default model for all tools. Overridden by per-tool CLAUDE_<TOOL>_MODEL vars (QUERY, SEARCH, STRUCTURED).

env.name: CLAUDE_QUERY_MODEL
env.description: Override model for the query tool.

env.name: CLAUDE_STRUCTURED_MODEL
env.description: Override model for the structured tool.

env.name: CLAUDE_SEARCH_MODEL
env.description: Override model for the search tool.

env.name: CLAUDE_FALLBACK_MODEL
env.description: Model to use when the primary model hits a quota error. Set to 'none' to disable fallback.

env.name: CLAUDE_BRIDGE_USE_API_KEY
env.description: Set to '1' to forward ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to the CLI. Default is subscription-first: the CLI uses existing Max/Pro session and API key is NOT forwarded. Opt in only if you want API billing.

env.name: CLAUDE_MAX_BUDGET_USD
env.description: Maximum USD spend per call (pass-through to --max-budget-usd). Only applies when using API key auth.

env.name: CLAUDE_QUERY_EFFORT
env.description: Reasoning effort for the query tool (low|medium|high|max).

env.name: CLAUDE_SEARCH_EFFORT
env.description: Reasoning effort for the search tool (low|medium|high|max).
